messages:
alex: Heads-up — console active session counts spiking on streaming endpoints. Correlates with reconnect flurries from mobile SDKs. I think proxy/origin TTL negotiation is drifting and we're double-counting sessions.

mira: Which metric are you looking at? I saw a brief blip earlier but assumed sampling noise.

alex: active_stream_sessions (v1) and token_charges_stream. Pattern: client attempts resume -> origin rejects (410) -> proxy opens new socket -> both resume failure and new session increments. Proxy rewrites/remove X-Resume-Id so console can’t reconcile.

sam: Repro'd locally with small script. Logs: {route: "ws/v1/stream", resume_id: "abc123", origin_resp:410, proxy_new_session: "def456"}. I can share the script.

mira: Could adding explicit handshake headers help? e.g. `X-Stream-TTL`, `X-Resume-Id`, `X-Session-Origin`. We discussed this before.

alex: Proposal: 1) introduce `X-Stream-TTL` in handshake so proxies and origin agree on lifetime; 2) origin should emit telemetry tag `session_origin` and `resume_result`; 3) add temporal deduper at origin (dedupe by resume_id for N seconds to avoid double increment).

sam: Quick patch idea on origin side: only increment active count when `seen_resume(resume_id)` returns false. Pseudocode:

```
# on resume handshake
if resume_id:
  if seen_recently(resume_id, window=45s):
    emit_metric('session.dedupe.skipped')
  else:
    increment_active_sessions()
    record_resume_id(resume_id)
else:
  increment_active_sessions()
```

mira: I like making the window configurable (45s default). Also we should expose both `active_stream_sessions_v1` and `active_stream_sessions_v2` in the console during rollout so SRE/product can compare.

jordan: Quota system caveat: our quota leases operate on windows that can overlap with dedupe window. We must ensure dedupe doesn't allow a client to bypass quota by constantly failing resume then opening new sessions. Suggest we add a dedupe + resume-failure counter (`resume_flap_count`) and surface it to billing.

sam: Good call. I'll add a `resume_flap_count` metric and a tag `resume_result:{ok,410,timeout}`. That helps correlate billing spikes.

mira: UX: Console needs a new dashboard tile: "Streaming sessions (v2)" showing total, deduped_skips, resume_flap_count, and a lightweight alert when deduped_skips > 100/min. Roll via feature flag to avoid breaking dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Release started: streaming-proxy v3.12.4 -> canary (3 pods) by @dylan.

alex: Sam — can you open a PR with proxy header passthrough + origin dedupe + telemetry tags `session_origin`,`resume_result`,`session_ttl_ms`? Also add unit test simulating resume-410->new-session race.

sam: PR opened: https://internal/infra/pr/789 (contains tests + metrics + config flag `streaming.dedupe_window_s`). I ran basic local jitter test, looks promising.

jordan: For canary tuning: make dedupe window 45s, but keep `streaming.dedupe_window_s` overridable per-namespace. Also make sure we time out resume_id entries with TTL equal to `max(client_ttl, dedupe_window)` to avoid memory leak.

mira: Plan: PR -> 2 reviewer approvals -> canary 3 pods -> run 30min reconnect jitter test (replay mobile patterns) -> check metrics: `active_stream_sessions_v2`, `session.dedupe.skipped`, `resume_flap_count`, `token_charges_stream`. If stable -> gradual rollout.

alex: I'll update runbook playbook/streaming-reconnect.md with how to interpret `deduped_skips` vs `resume_flap_count`. Also add a troubleshooting bullet for "proxy rewrites X-Resume-Id".

sam: One more detail: proxy may terminate TLS and re-encode headers. We should ensure `X-Resume-Id` is preserved end-to-end and maybe sign it with `X-Resume-Sig` to prevent proxies from accidentally zeroing it out. 

mira: Signing seems heavy but safe. Maybe a simple HMAC using request_id and shared secret between proxy and origin. Add as opt-in behind feature flag.

jordan: We'll want a dashboard query to show route-level diffs: `sum(active_stream_sessions_v2) by (route) - sum(active_stream_sessions_v1) by (route)` so we can detect regressions per route.

sam: Test infra note: I'll add a Chaos run that simulates resume 50% fail + jittered reconnects. Run on canary.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll review PR today. alex/jordan — assign me if you want quick turnaround.

alex: Thanks everyone. Sam, once canary metrics look good let's roll the console feature flag so product can see the new counters.

sam: Will do. PR includes migration note and a tip for ops `debug: curl -H "Upgrade: websocket" -H "X-Resume-Id: abc" ...`

jordan: :eyes: monitoring during canary. Ping here for any anomalies.

mira: closing loop: add docs entry in internal docs/streaming-telemetry.md about new fields and recommended alert thresholds.

alex: Perfect. We'll reconvene if canary shows anything unexpected. Cheers.
